question: which district has lower employment rate in 2023? list everyone low to high
gold_sql: SELECT district, ROUND(100.0 * employed_at_6_months / women_enrolled, 1) AS employment_percent FROM livelihoods WHERE year = 2023 ORDER BY employment_percent ASC, district
sql_duckdb: SELECT T1.district FROM livelihoods AS T1 INNER JOIN anc_visits AS T2 ON T1.district = T2.district AND T1.year = T2.year WHERE T1.year = 2023 ORDER BY T1.employed_at_6_months / NULLIF(T1.women_enrolled, 0) * 100.0 ASC NULLS FIRST
